WITH nationality_totals AS (
    SELECT
        r.year AS season,
        d.nationality,
        SUM(ds.points) AS total_points
    FROM driverStandings ds
    JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.year, d.nationality
)
SELECT
    season,
    total_points AS british_total_points,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rank
FROM nationality_totals
WHERE nationality = 'British'
ORDER BY season;

WITH mc AS (
    SELECT "constructorId"
    FROM "constructors"
    WHERE "name" = 'McLaren'
),
season_mc AS (
    SELECT r."year" AS "year",
           SUM(CASE WHEN q."position" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "pole_count",
           AVG(res."position") AS "avg_mc"
    FROM "results" res
    JOIN "races" r ON res."raceId" = r."raceId"
    JOIN mc ON res."constructorId" = mc."constructorId"
    LEFT JOIN "qualifying" q ON q."raceId" = r."raceId" AND q."constructorId" = mc."constructorId"
    GROUP BY r."year"
),
other_avg AS (
    SELECT r."year" AS "year",
           c."constructorId",
           AVG(res."position") AS "avg_pos"
    FROM "results" res
    JOIN "races" r ON res."raceId" = r."raceId"
    JOIN "constructors" c ON res."constructorId" = c."constructorId"
    WHERE c."nationality" = 'British'
      AND c."constructorId" <> (SELECT "constructorId" FROM mc)
    GROUP BY r."year", c."constructorId"
)
SELECT sm."year"
FROM season_mc sm
WHERE sm."pole_count" >= 3
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM other_avg oa
        WHERE oa."year" = sm."year" AND oa."avg_pos" <= sm."avg_mc"
      );

WITH british_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructorId, name
    FROM constructors
    WHERE nationality = 'British'
),
mclaren_pole_years AS (
    SELECT r.year
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN constructors c ON q.constructorId = c.constructorId
    WHERE c.name = 'McLaren' AND q.position = 1
    GROUP BY r.year
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
british_season_avg_positions AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        c.constructorId,
        c.name,
        AVG(res.position) as avg_position
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorId = c.constructorId
    WHERE c.nationality = 'British'
    AND r.year IN (SELECT year FROM mclaren_pole_years)
    GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorId, c.name
),
mclaren_avg AS (
    SELECT year, avg_position
    FROM british_season_avg_positions
    WHERE name = 'McLaren'
),
other_british_avg AS (
    SELECT year, avg_position
    FROM british_season_avg_positions
    WHERE name != 'McLaren'
)
SELECT mp.year
FROM mclaren_avg mp
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM other_british_avg ob
    WHERE ob.year = mp.year
    AND ob.avg_position <= mp.avg_position
);

WITH "mclaren_id" AS (SELECT "constructorId" FROM "constructors" WHERE "name" = 'McLaren'),
     "pole_counts" AS (
         SELECT r."year" AS "season", COUNT(DISTINCT q."raceId") AS "pole_count"
         FROM "qualifying" q
         JOIN "races" r ON q."raceId" = r."raceId"
         JOIN "mclaren_id" m ON q."constructorId" = m."constructorId"
         WHERE q."position" = 1
         GROUP BY r."year"
     ),
     "mclaren_avg" AS (
         SELECT r."year" AS "season", AVG(res."position") AS "avg_pos"
         FROM "results" res
         JOIN "races" r ON res."raceId" = r."raceId"
         JOIN "mclaren_id" m ON res."constructorId" = m."constructorId"
         GROUP BY r."year"
     ),
     "british_constructors" AS (
         SELECT "constructorId" FROM "constructors" WHERE "nationality" = 'British'
     ),
     "other_avg" AS (
         SELECT r."year" AS "season", c."constructorId", AVG(res."position") AS "avg_pos"
         FROM "results" res
         JOIN "races" r ON res."raceId" = r."raceId"
         JOIN "british_constructors" c ON res."constructorId" = c."constructorId"
         WHERE c."constructorId" <> (SELECT "constructorId" FROM "mclaren_id")
         GROUP BY r."year", c."constructorId"
     ),
     "min_other_avg" AS (
         SELECT "season", MIN("avg_pos") AS "min_other_avg"
         FROM "other_avg"
         GROUP BY "season"
     )
SELECT DISTINCT "mclaren_avg"."season"
FROM "mclaren_avg"
JOIN "pole_counts" ON "mclaren_avg"."season" = "pole_counts"."season"
JOIN "min_other_avg" ON "mclaren_avg"."season" = "min_other_avg"."season"
WHERE "pole_counts"."pole_count" >= 3
  AND "mclaren_avg"."avg_pos" < "min_other_avg"."min_other_avg";

WITH renault AS (
    SELECT constructorId FROM constructors WHERE name = 'Renault'
),
french_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructorId FROM constructors WHERE nationality = 'French'
),
pole_counts AS (
    SELECT r.year,
           COUNT(DISTINCT q.raceId) AS pole_cnt
    FROM races r
    JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE q.constructorId = (SELECT constructorId FROM renault)
      AND q.position = 1
    GROUP BY r.year
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT q.raceId) >= 3
),
renault_avg AS (
    SELECT r.year,
           AVG(res.position) AS avg_pos
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.constructorId = (SELECT constructorId FROM renault)
    GROUP BY r.year
),
other_french_avg AS (
    SELECT sub.year,
           MIN(sub.avg_pos) AS min_other_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT r.year,
               res.constructorId,
               AVG(res.position) AS avg_pos
        FROM races r
        JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
        WHERE res.constructorId IN (
            SELECT constructorId FROM french_constructors
            WHERE constructorId <> (SELECT constructorId FROM renault)
        )
        GROUP BY r.year, res.constructorId
    ) sub
    GROUP BY sub.year
)
SELECT pc.year
FROM pole_counts pc
JOIN renault_avg ra ON pc.year = ra.year
JOIN other_french_avg ofa ON pc.year = ofa.year
WHERE ra.avg_pos < ofa.min_other_avg;

WITH french_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructorId, name
    FROM constructors
    WHERE nationality = 'French'
),
pole_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        q.constructorId,
        r.year,
        COUNT(*) as pole_count
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN french_constructors fc ON q.constructorId = fc.constructorId
    WHERE q.position = 1
    GROUP BY q.constructorId, r.year
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
avg_positions AS (
    SELECT 
        res.constructorId,
        r.year,
        AVG(res.position * 1.0) as avg_position
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN french_constructors fc ON res.constructorId = fc.constructorId
    GROUP BY res.constructorId, r.year
),
qualified_constructors AS (
    SELECT pc.constructorId, pc.year, pc.pole_count, ap.avg_position
    FROM pole_counts pc
    JOIN avg_positions ap ON pc.constructorId = ap.constructorId AND pc.year = ap.year
),
best_per_year AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        MIN(avg_position) as best_avg
    FROM qualified_constructors
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT qc.year
FROM qualified_constructors qc
JOIN best_per_year bp ON qc.year = bp.year AND qc.avg_position = bp.best_avg;

WITH renault AS (
  SELECT constructorId FROM constructors WHERE name = 'Renault'
),
renault_poles AS (
  SELECT r.year, COUNT(*) AS pole_count
  FROM races r
  JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = r.raceId AND q.constructorId = (SELECT constructorId FROM renault) AND q.position = 1
  GROUP BY r.year
),
renault_finish AS (
  SELECT r.year, AVG(res.position) AS avg_finish_pos
  FROM races r
  JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId AND res.constructorId = (SELECT constructorId FROM renault)
  GROUP BY r.year
),
renault_stats AS (
  SELECT p.year, p.pole_count, f.avg_finish_pos
  FROM renault_poles p
  JOIN renault_finish f ON f.year = p.year
  WHERE p.pole_count >= 3
),
other_french AS (
  SELECT r.year,
         c.constructorId,
         AVG(res.position) AS avg_finish_pos
  FROM races r
  JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
  JOIN (SELECT constructorId FROM constructors WHERE nationality = 'French' AND constructorId != (SELECT constructorId FROM renault)) fr ON fr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorId
)
SELECT rs.year
FROM renault_stats rs
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM other_french of
  WHERE of.year = rs.year
    AND of.avg_finish_pos <= rs.avg_finish_pos
);
